label: GitLab

sensitivePaths.label: Delete a project
sensitivePaths.warning: The code and its history are gone.

agentGuide: Base path /api/v4; projects are addressed by numeric id or by URL-encoded path (group%2Fname). Me: GET /api/v4/user; my projects: GET /api/v4/projects?membership=true&per_page=20; search: GET /api/v4/projects?search=<words>. Issues: GET /api/v4/projects/<id>/issues?state=opened, create: POST ... {"title": "...", "description": "..."}, comment: POST .../issues/<iid>/notes {"body": "..."}. Merge requests: GET .../merge_requests?state=opened; pipelines: GET .../pipelines?per_page=10, jobs of one: GET .../pipelines/<id>/jobs, a job's log: GET .../jobs/<id>/trace. A file: GET .../repository/files/<url-encoded path>/raw?ref=main; commits: GET .../repository/commits?ref_name=main. Pagination in headers X-Total and X-Next-Page. The token is set by Allkin.
